<none>

<none> (None value) represents boolean false value variable.
Attributes Global attributes and those inherited from boolean
Example 
<f name="inflection"><none/></f>

Class boolean
Data Description Empty element.
May occur within f fvLib vAlt

<!ATTLIST none  
      %a.global;>
